up: Find all approved drugs (therapeutic_flag = 1 in molecule_dictionary) that have a COVID-19 indication. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno. Filter indications where efo_term or mesh_heading contains 'COVID-19', 'SARS-CoV-2', or 'Coronavirus Infection'. Return the drug's preferred name, ChEMBL ID, max clinical phase, and the exact indication text. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, md.max_phase, COALESCE(di.efo_term, di.mesh_heading) AS indication_text FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND (di.efo_term LIKE '%COVID-19%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%SARS-CoV-2%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%Coronavirus Infection%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%COVID-19%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%SARS-CoV-2%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Coronavirus Infection%')
